segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let enUSLocale = Locale(languageCode: .english, languageRegion: .unitedStates) let source = "7/31/2022, 5:15:12 PM Lemon-lime slushie $1.99" let matcher = Regex { Capture { One(.dateTime(date: .numeric, time: .standard, locale: enUSLocale, timeZone: TimeZone(identifier: "PST")!)) } OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) OneOrMore(.any) OneOrMore(.horizontalWhitespace) One(.localizedCurrency(code: Locale.Currency("USD"), locale: enUSLocale)) } guard let match = source.firstMatch(of: matcher) else { return } let date = match.1 // date == Jul 31, 2022 at 5:15 PM PST ```
